title: Trouble in Gangtok
subtitle: A Puzzling Mystery Amidst the Himalayan Clouds
summary: When detective Feluda and his companions arrive in the misty hills of Gangtok, an ordinary journey quickly turns into a web of intrigue. With enigmatic strangers on their flight and secrets clouding the landscape, Feluda must rely on his sharp intellect and keen observation to unravel a mystery that promises danger at every turn.
